fact: The Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar's Ministry of Communications, IT and Innovation signed a three-year MoU with Emerson Education Institute on 16 August 2026 to train an initial cohort of 600 officials in AI and cybersecurity, 50 per class, as reported by The Citizen.
system: Zanzibar AI and cybersecurity capacity-building programme

fact: Under the Digital Tanzania Project 500 government staff were trained, 50 on master's degrees abroad in AI and machine learning and 450 on short local courses, per project coordinator Bakari Mwamgugu.
